item.title: Siemens Industrial Software Products
item.description: View CSAF Summary On October 21, 2026, the Node.js project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js, commonly referred to as "Node2Shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-111497). The vulnerability is an out-of-bounds write that could allow a remote attacker to cause memory corruption and potentially execute arbitrary code. This advisory covers the status of impact of various Siemens software products. Please also have a look on following Software Field Bulletins: Teamcenter: https://support.sw.siemens.com/en-US/knowledge-base/PL8869204 Polar

item.title: The risks of device code authentication for AI coding agents
